annotations.title: Address profile: labels and track record

description: Who a large vault depositor is and what it has done, as facts. With address: its labels, each with source and confidence (whale by position size; fund, treasury, custodian, exchange, bridge, wrapper, vault or agent only where a registry, our vault index, the contract itself or a public tag names it; otherwise unidentified, never a person), its summary (position, vaults held and left, moves between vaults, first seen) and, paid, the track record: every vault entered and left with dates and dollars, holding periods and results, moves, the wallet outside vaults and capital in impaired markets. Without address: the largest depositors, filtered by label. A track record, not a prediction or a smart-money score. FREE for labels and summary.
